iptv-stream.h1: IPTV Stream: How Streaming Actually Works

paras: An IPTV stream is a continuous flow of video packets from a server to your player. The player buffers a few seconds to smooth out network variation. If your connection or the server cannot keep up, the buffer drains and you see freezing.
That is why both sides matter: your home network and the provider’s servers.
